title: Black-Box Misuse Resistance for Leakage-Resistant AE Modes
summary: The paper combines leakage resistance with nonce-misuse resilience, but leaves black-box misuse resistance as an additional mode requirement for future work.

formal_statement.body: Establish black-box nonce-misuse resistance as an additional property of the studied leakage-resistant AE modes.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography concerning leakage-resistant authenticated-encryption modes and their security properties.
parameters: The studied leakage-resistant AE modes: the mode constructions to which the additional property would apply
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish black-box nonce-misuse resistance as an additional property of the studied leakage-resistant AE modes.

citations.label: Mode-Level vs. Implementation-Level Physical Security in Symmetric Cryptography: A Practical Guide Through the Leakage-Resistance Jungle

progress.summary: The source presents this as future work: the limitation under discussion only holds in the presence of leakage, and black-box misuse resistance could be requested as an additional requirement of a mode. The paper does not consider that requirement.
citation_labels: Davide Bellizia et al., Mode-Level vs. Implementation-Level Physical Security in Symmetric Cryptography: A Practical Guide Through the Leakage-Resistance Jungle
